args:
# NOTE: this install-location file path is a best-known convention, not verified against a real macOS X-Plane install — adjust if it doesn't match yours.
installFile="$HOME/Library/Preferences/x-plane_install_12.txt"
[ -f "$installFile" ] || installFile="$HOME/Library/Preferences/x-plane_install_11.txt"
if ! pgrep -f 'X-Plane' > /dev/null; then
  if [ ! -f "$installFile" ]; then echo 'No X-Plane install-location file found; launch X-Plane manually once first.' >&2; exit 1; fi
  xpRoot=$(head -n1 "$installFile" | tr -d '\r\n')
  app=$(find "$xpRoot" -maxdepth 1 -iname 'X-Plane*.app' | head -n1)
  if [ -z "$app" ]; then echo "Could not find an X-Plane.app under $xpRoot" >&2; exit 1; fi
  echo "Starting $app..."
  open "$app"
  deadline=$((SECONDS + 120))
  until pgrep -f 'X-Plane' > /dev/null; do
    if [ $SECONDS -gt $deadline ]; then echo 'Timed out waiting for X-Plane to start.' >&2; exit 1; fi
    sleep 1
  done
  echo 'X-Plane process detected; first cold launch can take a while before flight loops start ticking.'
else
  echo 'X-Plane already running.'
fi

# NOTE: this install-location file path is a best-known convention, not verified against a real Linux X-Plane install — adjust if it doesn't match yours.
installFile="$HOME/.x-plane_install_12.txt"
[ -f "$installFile" ] || installFile="$HOME/.x-plane_install_11.txt"
if ! pgrep -f 'X-Plane' > /dev/null; then
  if [ ! -f "$installFile" ]; then echo 'No X-Plane install-location file found; launch X-Plane manually once first.' >&2; exit 1; fi
  xpRoot=$(head -n1 "$installFile" | tr -d '\r\n')
  exe=$(find "$xpRoot" -maxdepth 1 -iname 'X-Plane*' -executable -type f | head -n1)
  if [ -z "$exe" ]; then echo "Could not find an X-Plane executable under $xpRoot" >&2; exit 1; fi
  echo "Starting $exe..."
  nohup "$exe" > /dev/null 2>&1 &
  deadline=$((SECONDS + 120))
  until pgrep -f 'X-Plane' > /dev/null; do
    if [ $SECONDS -gt $deadline ]; then echo 'Timed out waiting for X-Plane to start.' >&2; exit 1; fi
    sleep 1
  done
  echo 'X-Plane process detected; first cold launch can take a while before flight loops start ticking.'
else
  echo 'X-Plane already running.'
fi

cargo build -p hot-reload-xpl
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
$installFile = "$env:LocalAppData\x-plane_install_12.txt"; if (-not (Test-Path $installFile)) { $installFile = "$env:LocalAppData\x-plane_install_11.txt" }
$xpRoot = (Get-Content $installFile -TotalCount 1).Trim()
$dest = Join-Path $xpRoot 'Resources\plugins\hot-reload-xpl\64'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dest | Out-Null
Copy-Item -Force 'target\debug\hot_reload_xpl.dll' (Join-Path $dest 'win.xpl')
Write-Host "Installed loader to $dest\win.xpl"

set -e
cargo build -p hot-reload-xpl
installFile="$HOME/Library/Preferences/x-plane_install_12.txt"
[ -f "$installFile" ] || installFile="$HOME/Library/Preferences/x-plane_install_11.txt"
xpRoot=$(head -n1 "$installFile" | tr -d '\r\n')
dest="$xpRoot/Resources/plugins/hot-reload-xpl/64"
mkdir -p "$dest"
cp -f target/debug/libhot_reload_xpl.dylib "$dest/mac.xpl"
echo "Installed loader to $dest/mac.xpl"

set -e
cargo build -p hot-reload-xpl
installFile="$HOME/.x-plane_install_12.txt"
[ -f "$installFile" ] || installFile="$HOME/.x-plane_install_11.txt"
xpRoot=$(head -n1 "$installFile" | tr -d '\r\n')
dest="$xpRoot/Resources/plugins/hot-reload-xpl/64"
mkdir -p "$dest"
cp -f target/debug/libhot_reload_xpl.so "$dest/lin.xpl"
echo "Installed loader to $dest/lin.xpl"

$id = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()
$messages = cargo rustc -p hot-reload-dll --lib --message-format=json -- -C extra-filename="-$id" | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
$artifact = $messages | Where-Object { $_.reason -eq 'compiler-artifact' -and $_.target.name -eq 'hot-reload-dll' } | Select-Object -Last 1
$dllPath = $artifact.filenames | Where-Object { $_ -like '*.dll' } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $dllPath) { throw 'Could not determine the built payload DLL path from cargo output.' }
$watchDir = Join-Path $env:LocalAppData 'xplm-hotreload'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $watchDir | Out-Null
$watchFile = Join-Path $watchDir 'hot-reload-example.json'
$tmpFile = "$watchFile.tmp"
@{ payload_path = $dllPath; build_id = "$id" } | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -Path $tmpFile -Encoding utf8
Move-Item -Force $tmpFile $watchFile
Write-Host "Published payload build $id -> $dllPath"

set -e
# Requires `jq` (brew install jq) to parse cargo's --message-format=json stream.
id=$(date +%s%3N)
dllPath=$(cargo rustc -p hot-reload-dll --lib --message-format=json -- -C extra-filename="-$id" | jq -r --arg name hot-reload-dll 'select(.reason=="compiler-artifact" and .target.name==$name) | .filenames[]' | grep -E '\.dylib$' | tail -n1)
if [ -z "$dllPath" ]; then echo 'Could not determine the built payload dylib path from cargo output.' >&2; exit 1; fi
watchDir="$HOME/Library/Application Support/xplm-hotreload"
mkdir -p "$watchDir"
watchFile="$watchDir/hot-reload-example.json"
jq -n --arg path "$dllPath" --arg id "$id" '{payload_path: $path, build_id: $id}' > "$watchFile.tmp"
mv -f "$watchFile.tmp" "$watchFile"
echo "Published payload build $id -> $dllPath"

set -e
# Requires `jq` (apt install jq / dnf install jq) to parse cargo's --message-format=json stream.
id=$(date +%s%3N)
dllPath=$(cargo rustc -p hot-reload-dll --lib --message-format=json -- -C extra-filename="-$id" | jq -r --arg name hot-reload-dll 'select(.reason=="compiler-artifact" and .target.name==$name) | .filenames[]' | grep -E '\.so$' | tail -n1)
if [ -z "$dllPath" ]; then echo 'Could not determine the built payload .so path from cargo output.' >&2; exit 1; fi
watchDir="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/xplm-hotreload"
mkdir -p "$watchDir"
watchFile="$watchDir/hot-reload-example.json"
jq -n --arg path "$dllPath" --arg id "$id" '{payload_path: $path, build_id: $id}' > "$watchFile.tmp"
mv -f "$watchFile.tmp" "$watchFile"
echo "Published payload build $id -> $dllPath"
